description: Semantic LLM judge evaluating CTA strength and specificity across every flywheel component. Evaluates: Substack share CTA specificity (who to forward to, why), LinkedIn Article Substack CTA placement (header+footer), LinkedIn Post Hub hook discipline (tension not resolution), X thread link placement (reply not body), Reddit link-in-comment vs body, Instagram bio-link reference, Facebook share ask, Comment Cascade backward-link specificity. Uses OAuth CLI (claude → gemini → codex fallback) — no API key required.
litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file — exit 0=strong CTAs across all components, exit 1=BLOCK (CTA kills click-through), exit 2=WARN (advisory or CI mode).

files.PROMPT.md: Judge prompt with CTA rules per platform — fed to claude -p along with campaign package
files.HOW.py: Collects campaign.json + all content files, pipes to CLI judge, returns structured verdict
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance scan — surfaces past BLOCK events from enforcement log
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — signals strengthen if block_rate > 40% (CTA discipline not internalized)

cta_conversion_chain.linkedin_article: reader clicks Subscribe + follows through to Substack
cta_conversion_chain.post_hub: reader clicks first-comment link to Article (NOT Substack directly)
cta_conversion_chain.comment_cascade: reader clicks backward or forward link

platform_rules.substack: specific share CTA with who/why/what — not generic
platform_rules.linkedin_article: Substack CTA at header AND footer — not end-only
platform_rules.post_hub: hook only, unresolved tension — BLOCK if summarizes
platform_rules.x_thread: link in reply not body — BLOCK if URL in main tweet
platform_rules.reddit: link in comment not body — BLOCK if self-promotion link in post
platform_rules.instagram: bio link reference required — BLOCK if missing
platform_rules.comment_cascade: specific backward-link copy referencing old content's topic

origin_incident: 2026-05-07: user flagged CTAs across flywheel items are not strong; campaigns were distributing with generic share asks and missing tension in Post Hub hooks.
